result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are all aligned and consistent. The only questionable element is the profile avatar in the top-right, which appears as an empty grey circle with a red dot floating inside it rather than a badge anchored to its edge.

issues.description: The profile/avatar button at the top right is a blank grey circle with no image, initials, or icon, and the red notification dot sits inside the circle (offset from center) rather than anchored at the corner edge, making it look like a failed image load or misplaced badge.
issues.suggestion: Render a fallback avatar (initials or user icon) when no photo is available, and position the notification badge on the top-right edge of the avatar circle so it reads as an intentional indicator.
